import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] scien, reac;
    static int[][][][] shortest;
    static int[][] reach, treach;
    static int[][] cap;
    static int totalNodes;

    static int getnode(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * n + (y - 1);
    }

    static void expand(int val) {
        // copy reach to treach
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(reach[i], 1, treach[i], 1, n);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k];
                        int nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reach[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) Arrays.fill(reach[i], 1, n+1, 0);
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        int iters = 100;
        while (iters-- > 0) {
            expand(1);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
            expand(2);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean bfs(int src, int sink, int[] parent) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        parent[src] = src;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v = 0; v <= sink; v++) {
                if (parent[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                    parent[v] = u;
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        scien = new char[n+2][n+2];
        reac = new char[n+2][n+2];
        int infx = 0, infy = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                scien[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                reac[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }

        // Initialize shortest with large values
        shortest = new int[n+1][n+1][n+1][n+1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(shortest[i][j][k], 1, n+1, Integer.MAX_VALUE/2);
                }
                shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        // Set direct edges
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni > 0 && ni <= n && nj > 0 && nj <= n && scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Floyd-Warshall-like
        for (int kx = 1; kx <= n; kx++) {
            for (int ky = 1; ky <= n; ky++) {
                for (int sx = 1; sx <= n; sx++) {
                    for (int sy = 1; sy <= n; sy++) {
                        for (int tx = 1; tx <= n; tx++) {
                            for (int ty = 1; ty <= n; ty++) {
                                int sum = shortest[sx][sy][kx][ky] + shortest[kx][ky][tx][ty];
                                if (sum < shortest[sx][sy][tx][ty]) {
                                    shortest[sx][sy][tx][ty] = sum;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        totalNodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
        cap = new int[totalNodes][totalNodes];
        int src = n * n * 2;
        int sink = n * n * 2 + 1;

        // Initialize reach and treach arrays
        reach = new int[n+2][n+2];
        treach = new int[n+2][n+2];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reac[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][sink] = reac[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) {
                        for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
                            if (scien[i][j] > '0' && reac[a][b] > '0' && Character.isDigit(reac[a][b]) &&
                                shortest[i][j][a][b] <= t && canreach(i, j, a, b, infx, infy)) {
                                cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(a, b)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int flow = 0;
        int[] parent = new int[totalNodes];
        while (bfs(src, sink, parent)) {
            int bottleneck = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = sink; v != src; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, cap[u][v]);
            }
            for (int v = sink; v != src; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                cap[u][v] -= bottleneck;
                cap[v][u] += bottleneck;
            }
            flow += bottleneck;
        }
        System.out.println(flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
